subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with a suitable word of your own based on the information in the text. 0.
stimulus: i. These are the stories of two most successful Olympians of the history. While one is famous as the fastest (a) ___, the other as the fastest (b)___ of the world. However, both are unparallel for their (c) ___ in their own field. They made history in the Beijing (d)___. They have made newer (e) ___ in the London Olympics too. They are the living (f)___ now. Though Phelps has (g)___ from his race, Bolt has prospects to (h)___ himself in the next Olympic as well. After the (i)___ show on earth is over in London; this (j)___ will go on-who is better. Only time will answer this question. Extra Practices ii. The text (a) ___ on the histories of the two greatest (b)___ of this planet. They have (c)___ others in their respective fields. Michael Phelps is an (d)___ recognized best swimmer and he bears (e)___ to this in the Olympics. He has a record of getting 22 overall medals. There is a (f)___ to another greatest world famous hero, who although fresh, has (g)___ able to get the highest record in (h)___. He is a self- (i)___ legend. He has (j)___ to go far into his career which will undoubtedly cement his reputation and records.
guide_solution: i. (a) swimmer; (b) sprinter; (c) histories; (d) Olympics; (e) speed; (f) legends; (g) retired; (h) prove; (i) biggest; (j) debate. ii. (a) focuses; (b) athletes; (c) excelled; (d) internationally; (e) testimony; (f) reference; (g) been; (h) sprinting; (i) declared; (j) potential.
